facets.label: Creature type
facets.note: Labels are the client UI strings (UI_MAINTARGET_CREATURETYPE_*); raw enum in brackets.

facets.label: Tribe (client key)
facets.note: The client has no localized tribe names; the raw key is shown. Only a minority of monsters have a tribe; the rest are Unknown.

facets.label: Aggro behaviour
facets.note: Interpretation of AggroNormal vs Aggro_A is inferred from the enum names; raw value is shown in popups.

facets.label: Relationship
facets.note: Raw client relationship groups are never merged. "Monster" is the standard hostile group; Team/other groups are shown as-is.

notes: spawn_count counts spawn LOCATIONS (one record per map position); unique_entity_count counts distinct entity_id values (client NpcData/EnvObjData ids).
Display names are not identities: several entity_ids can share one name (e.g. many "Guard" NPC ids).
